Nontrivial Markov type means a uniform Markov-type bound for some exponent $p>1$ over all finite stationary reversible chains and all positive times. The exponent and equivalent norm may depend on the space, and the zero space is included. Additional formalized consequences concern uniformly smooth renormings and reflexivity of finitely representable spaces.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
